title: Can I Beat The SINTA Bot?
summary: Christmas video: revenge on chess.com's holiday 'SINTA' bot (a creepy Santa with a smirk and a suspicious wig, whose rating is hidden - the card just shows '!!'). Santa chats Christmas lines ('I see when you're sleeping and I know when you're awake', 'Ho...ho...ho...'). The creator plays the London, castles long, pushes on the h-file but Santa breaks through and checkmates him ('you've earned a spot on the naughty list ho ho ho'); he estimates Santa at ~2400-2500 and reviews the missed defensive motif.
rules: Normal chess, standard start, vs a single holiday bot.
